facts.text: A vehicle and machine dynamics tool calculates how a machine accelerates, steers, tips, sinks into soft ground and stops when the brakes act.
facts.quote: A vehicle and machine dynamics tool calculates how a machine moves: how it accelerates, steers, tips, sinks into soft ground and stops when the brakes act.

facts.text: The quality of a braking test depends on the quality of the machine model.
facts.quote: A braking test is only as good as the model of the machine.

facts.text: Vehicle and machine dynamics tools calculate forces on the machine's frame, boom, bucket, wheels or tracks, the hydraulics that move them, and ground contact many times per second.
facts.quote: Dynamics tools calculate the forces on every body of the machine (frame, boom, bucket, wheels or tracks), the hydraulics that move them and the contact with the ground, many times per second.
